test_shot.contents: S5 re-shuffle (216 f) + S6 push into page 1 (18 f) + cut B opening: 05 src 0-59 at 0.5x (5.0 s), 04 src 0-47 (2.0 s), 02 src 24-95 (full 3.0 s)

timeline_change: S5 is 216 f (9.0 s), not 192: one print per page means 4 spreads, so the re-shuffle needs a riffle back from spread 4 and 4 page turns. Everything after S5 shifts +24 f; the film is 1608 f = 67.0 s (within 60-75 s). Rig constants S5_TURNS / S5_MOVES / S5_MARKS are data and can be re-timed.
choreography_change: 01 is parked on the table beside the notebook (left), not in the gutter: with a print filling each page there is no gutter room. Prints are carried in two table stacks (L: 01,03; R: 02,04,05,06) so only 4 page turns are needed; the hole-cycle order of the brief (05->1, 03->5, 02->3, 04->2, 06->4, 01->6) is kept as the set of slot changes, but the moves happen grouped by spread: 02->3, then 03->5 and 01->6, then 06->4, then 05->1 and 04->2. Red pencil strikes old ink number and writes the new one (8 f) on each moved slip; A struck and B written on page 1 at the end; 0.8 s hold.
layout_per_user_review: one print per page, two pages per spread, broad cream margins, print in upper third (740x540 box on a 1000x1360 page)

page = slot; print, typed tape and ink number travel together on a slip of the same stock, which is not drawn while flush on a page (it reads as pasted directly); its edge and shadow show only while lifted or parked on the table
fine wire coil, 36 thin slanted loops through punched holes (denser than the brief's ~24, matched by eye to the reference)
red pencil numbers true red (200,20,30 core), 8 px stroke, same 58 px height as the ink numbers, grainy and broken
red page number in thin red ink in each outer top corner
02 woman with parcel projection gets its full 3 s
prints from the LoC master TIFFs (registrar downloads) via an integer-reduce pyramid; no service JPEGs

measured.note_pull: pull-outs now start on the window of the last projected frame (08 src 47 in A, 95 in B, PULL_SRC); re-check after editors finalise recipes
measured.final_slots_check: check_final_slots(): slot k holds B[k], 07 and 08 never move: True
measured.translation_ncc_note: NCC 1.0 for unoccluded moving prints at f740; 05 reads 0.10 there because the lifted 06 slip lies over it (occlusion, not geometry)

scion_application.40: rigid paper pieces, translation only, frame-indexed event stream (84 events: cover_flip, turn, lift, travel, setdown, settle, strike, write, push, pull, slide, line, tape); no wrong-ID swaps asserted
scion_application.41: lift shadow offset 2->22 px and blur 1.5->23.5 px with height over 4 f; damped spring at set-down (7 table px = ~2.5 out px overshoot, decays and snaps within 12 f = 6 drawings); loose sheet with leading-edge shadow and small settle; nothing moves at rest except the +-0.6 px table jitter per drawing (notebook layer only, ramped to 0 on pushes)
scion_application.27: pure function of frame index + data + fixed seeds; on twos for paper, ones for camera moves; deterministic re-render

handmade.item: spiral notebook: cream pages with fibre noise, faint gutter, punched holes, fine wire coil; pale table
red pebbled cover #610e18 with two white labels lettered stroke by stroke in black felt-pen capitals (my single-stroke hand); 6-drawing cover flip
typed tape captions in French, Courier 10 Pitch (Bitstream, freely redistributable system font), every character struck with its own density/baseline, yellowed band #dfbe87
pen numbers, red-pencil strikes and re-numbers, red-ink page numbers, A/B, coda columns: stroke-by-stroke engine with pressure, per-instance jitter, pencil tooth grain
rigid page turns (perspective foreshortening; declared in ledger as frames where prints on the turning leaf are not pool-resolved)
loose sheet with A/B columns, 8 red permutation lines drawn 6 f each, typed hash tape
test-shot sound: room tone, card hiss/taps, pencil scratches, page-turn flaps cued from the event stream; concourse murmur bed, ticks and pre-lapped latch synthesised with kit.Mix

files: work/<id>_pyr.png (gray master pyramids, required by the rig)

absences.searched: Commons File:WWS TheStationTunnelOfTheTampereStation.ogg (Work With Sounds / Werstas, CC BY 4.0 read from extmetadata) as the station bed
absences.result: upload.wikimedia.org returned HTTP 429 on 8 attempts with backoff 20 s to 8 min (13:09 to 13:22); not used

absences.searched: movingimagearchive.com cache: forage.py "station|depot|terminal|concourse|platform|railroad|railway|train" clips with source sound
absences.result: hits are music, narration or silent (index audio kind: Big Train 1950 music, 6 1/2 Magic Hours 1958 speech, Coney Island at Night 1940 silent, Berlin Symphony no audio, Third Avenue El 3 s only); no usable station ambience without music or voice; not used

known_gaps: the station bed is still handmade (synthesised); the sound unit owns T1 and may still get the Commons file
page turns foreshorten the prints on the turning leaf (a physical turn, declared per frame in the ledger as "turning"); the validator should treat these frames like S9 and not as pool appearances
the parked slips on the table read as loose paper slips; at rest in the notebook they are invisible
the cover lettering is my own felt-pen hand; spacing around the I is a little uneven
the test shot was not watched by an independent critic; I checked it only from frame strips and stills (perceptual check by me)
